event.title: Ancient Shipyard
event.description: An automated orbital drydock, {subject}, drifts in {sector}. Its repair gantries and fabrication bays still hum with power.
event.successStory: The shipyard gantries deliver {loot} into the cargo bay.
event.failureStory: Automated defense clamps misfire, forcing a hasty undocking from {subject}.
event.criticalSuccessStory: Full fabrication access granted! The crew secures {loot} and installs custom hull plating.
event.partialSuccessStory: A gantry crane jams mid-cycle; the crew salvages {loot} while taking minor hull scrapes.
event.neutralStory: The shipyard's central computer rejects the docking handshake and powers down.
event.criticalFailureStory: Automated security lasers sweep the docking bay, carving into the hull before undocking!

steps.prompt: An automated orbital drydock, {subject}, drifts in {sector}. How should the crew approach?

choices.label: Transmit ancient docking codes
choices.story: {crew} broadcasts a legacy maintenance handshake to {subject}.

choices.label: Strip the outer slips
choices.story: {crewlist} cut salvage directly from the outer slips of {subject}.

steps.prompt: The gantry bay doors open, revealing active repair cradles and a sealed fabricator vault.

choices.label: Engage automated hull refit
choices.story: {crew} aligns the ship with the primary refit cradles.

choices.label: Overclock the fabricator vault
choices.story: {crew} overrides the fabricator safeties for maximum output.

steps.prompt: The drydock repairs the ship and installs reinforced plating alongside {loot}.
The crew hauls {loot} from the shipyard bays.
The crew undocks and leaves {subject} behind.
